title: Reindexing morphism record
description: Morphism: a predication fiber algebra A_p -> the predication hyperdoctrine over it, after verifying the reindexing functors and their adjoints. Converse f* swaps the entity-pair (verified involution + commutes with negation). Subject projection pulls a unary fiber back to binary (g(s,o)=g(s)); its left adjoint exists_object and right adjoint forall_object are truth-join/meet over the object; the Galois adjunctions exists -| pi* -| forall are verified (unit and counit) over the truth order. Object projection is symmetric (quantify over the subject).
